decisions.boundary_condition: Treat afternoon as a soft time-of-day preference; consider nearby departures when true afternoon options are limited or otherwise unattractive.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer afternoon departures for the return leg, with nearby times acceptable when afternoon options are limited or unattractive.
decisions.condition: When booking or comparing a round trip and selecting the return-leg departure time.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize return flights departing in the afternoon and present those options first.
decisions.exception_condition: Do not apply this return-leg preference to the outbound leg, and follow any explicit trip-specific timing requirement instead.
decisions.name: afternoon_return_departure_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefer the return flight to depart in the afternoon.
decisions.rationale: Multiple examples support a recurring, return-leg-specific preference for afternoon departures, including explicit requests for afternoon returns alongside a morning outbound. The evidence supports a soft preference rather than a strict cutoff.

decisions.boundary_condition: Apply this to departure time rather than arrival time, without inferring a strict after-6:00-p.m. threshold.
decisions.canonical_value: When departure timing is flexible, softly prefer afternoon or evening departures.
decisions.condition: When choosing a flight departure time and no explicit trip-specific timing requirement takes precedence.
decisions.default_action: Present afternoon and evening departure options first.
decisions.exception_condition: Follow an explicitly requested morning departure or any other trip-specific timing constraint instead.
decisions.name: prefer_afternoon_or_evening_departures
decisions.preference_value: Prefer flight departures in the afternoon or evening when timing is flexible.
decisions.rationale: The examples provide recurring support for later departure choices, including an explicit afternoon-or-evening preference and an after-6:00-p.m. request. Mixed leg-specific evidence warrants retaining this only as a soft general default that yields to explicit timing constraints.
